name: zmath_vec3_delta_length
description: zMath::Vec3DeltaLength stores a-b in the shared zMath delta scratch vector and returns the Euclidean length of that delta.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zMath vector source-cluster pass.
The original body stores the delta to the shared scratch vector before computing length through x87 fsqrt; the functional source preserves the shared scratch side effect.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4726d0 validates ECX as lhs, EDX as rhs, no direct callees, stores lhs-rhs into g_zMath_Vec3DeltaScratch, squares and sums the scratch components, and returns fsqrt of that sum.
The native zMath smoke verifies the returned distance and the shared scratch vector side effect.
